name: Personal Expense Analytics
description: Local expense exploration with strict CSV validation, keyword categories, budgets, and explainable spending insights.
summary: A local-first dashboard for understandable transaction exploration and budget comparisons. Explicit keyword rules preserve reviewability; refunds are included in calculations and uploaded data is not persisted.
architecture: A Streamlit entry point coordinates independent loading, categorization, calculations, UI, and budget modules. Pandas/NumPy aggregate validated records; Altair charts render results. Uploads and budgets stay in process/session memory, with no database or ML service.

capabilities.name: Expense exploration
capabilities.description: Filter validated transactions and inspect totals, category trends, and ranked expenses.

capabilities.name: Monthly budgets
capabilities.description: Compare month and category limits with actual spending, including refunds.

capabilities.name: Transparent categorization
capabilities.description: Review ordered keyword matches before replacing existing categories.

stack.usage: Widgets manage dataset selection, filters, categorization review, and session budgets.
Pure Python modules implement budget comparisons and keyword rules independently of the UI.
DataFrames validate uploaded rows and compute date/category summaries without discarding refunds.
NumPy supports numeric checks and aggregation calculations.
Interactive charts show spending trends and category comparisons with hover, pan, and zoom.
unittest and Streamlit AppTest cover validation, calculations, and app regressions.
Repository workflows run automated checks for the analytics modules.

architectureConnections.description: Filtered transaction summaries feed interactive expense charts.

evidence.notes: Reviewed repository README and available dependency manifests. Capabilities describe implemented workflows; roadmap items are excluded.
